Name: Luck Skill for 1.6
Author: ArdiyDev
Description:
[b][size=5]Description[/size][/b]

This mod introduces a fully functional [b]Luck Skill[/b] for Stardew Valley 1.6! It seamlessly integrates into the game, allowing you to level up your luck just like any other skill. By leveling up, you can unlock unique professions that alter daily luck, quest frequencies, nightly events, and even trigger special Junimo interactions.

[b][size=5]Main features[/size][/b]


[list]
[*][b]New Luck Skill:[/b] Gain passive daily luck bonuses as you level up from 1 to 10.[/*]
[*][b]Multiple XP Sources:[/b] Earn Luck XP by cracking or picking up geodes, opening fishing treasure chests, successfully panning for ores, winning at the Casino, or finding a Prismatic Shard. (All XP values are adjustable).[/*]
[*][b]6 Unique Professions:[/b] Choose between different paths at levels 5 and 10, such as [i]Fortunate[/i], [i]Popular Helper[/i], [i]Lucky[/i], [i]Un-unlucky[/i], [i]Shooting Star[/i], and [i]Spirit Child[/i].[/*]
[*][b]In-Game Configuration:[/b] Fully compatible with Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) to adjust XP rates and toggle HUD notifications.[/*]
[*][b]Multi-Language Support:[/b] Currently supports 8 languages (English, Thai, Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Korean).[/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Installation instructions[/size][/b]


[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[*]Install [b]SpaceCore[/b] (Required framework for custom skills).[/*]
[*]Download this mod, extract the
[code].zip[/code]file, and place the
[code]LuckSkill[/code]folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI![/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b]


[list]
[*]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/*]
[*]SpaceCore[/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Customization & Call for Artists! 🎨[/size][/b]

[b]Don't like the default skill icons?[/b] You can easily change them! Just navigate to the
[code]LuckSkill[/code]mod folder, find the
[code].png[/code]files (e.g.,
[code]icon.png[/code],
[code]fortunate.png[/code]), and replace them with your own 16x16 pixel art. Make sure to keep the original file names! [b]Are you a pixel artist?[/b] I am currently looking for talented artists to help design better profession icons for this mod. If you are interested in contributing, please reach out or send me a message!

[b][size=5]Translations & Localization 🌍[/size][/b]

While this mod supports many languages, some translations were generated with the help of automated tools.
[list]
[*][b]Found a translation error?[/b] Please leave a comment or message me with suggestions or corrections. Your help is highly appreciated![/*]
[*][b]Want your language added?[/b] If your language isn't included and you'd like to help translate, please contact me and I will gladly add it in the next update![/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Shout outs[/size][/b]

A huge thanks to the creator of [i]SpaceCore[/i] for providing the framework that makes custom skills possible, and to [i]ConcernedApe[/i] for creating Stardew Valley!
